title: Gaimingka API
description: A mod add some plants and fluids and Airs Blocks
body:
This API has the ID recipesapi, and it is a dependency mod for the the titans expanded. It is an API that adds air blocks and plants.
Add Blue Rose Green orchid Nether Flower Paeonia
Add Air Blocks
The titans expanded URLhttps://modrinth.com/datapack/the-titans-expand
All added item XP: Boiling Water, Nether Flower, Peaonia, Green Orchid, Blue Rose (compatible with Bedrock features Mod 's blue rose), Air Blocks.
The Mod MCreator Workplaces Links:https://www.ldmkc.cn/234156
